{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Shadow Cabinet of Thailand (Thai: คณะรัฐมนตรีเงา or รัฐบาลเงา) is an unofficial group of senior opposition party's spokespeople who form an alternative cabinet to the government.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The shadow cabinet members shadow or mark each individual member of the government.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" After the People's Power Party's win in the 2007 general election, the Democrat Party became the sole official opposition party.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Abhisit Vejjajiva, leader of the Democrat Party, expressed his intention to set up a shadow cabinet to track the new administration's performance, to propose better solutions, and to provide the Democrat's standpoint on each government decision.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The shadow cabinet line-up was announced on February 8, 2008 after the Samak's administration had officially assumed office.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" On the 15 December 2008, Abhisit was elected by the House of Representatives to become the next Prime Minister, within a week a Cabinet will be formed which will include many members his Shadow Cabinet.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" However a day later the For Thais Party (the opposition party) MP Jatuporn Promphan stated that his party will not be forming a Shadow Cabinet.","title":"Shadow Cabinet of Thailand"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"This article lists the members of President Donald Trump's Cabinet.","title":"Cabinet of Donald Trump"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Trump assumed office on January 20, 2017.","title":"Cabinet of Donald Trump"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"January 20, 2017","question":"The President whose cabinet James Mattis served on assumed office on what date?"}
